tpl: The next attack deals {0} ATK as Arts damage and {1} of damage as Nervous Impairment; if target is under the burst effect of Nervous Impairment, deals an additional {2} ATK as Elemental Damage

Attack Interval reduces slightly, attacks deal {0} ATK as Arts damage and jump between up to 2 other enemies, and jumps deal {1} ATK as Arts damage; attacks and jumps deal an additional {2} of damage as Nervous Impairment; if target is under the burst effect of Nervous Impairment, deals an additional {3} ATK as Elemental Damage

Attack Interval reduces, attacks deal {0} ATK as Arts damage and jump between up to 3 other enemies, and jumps deal {1} ATK as Arts damage; attacks and jumps deal an additional {2} of damage as Nervous Impairment; if target is under the burst effect of Nervous Impairment, deals an additional {3} ATK as Elemental Damage

Attack Range expands; enemies within Attack Range lose Invisibility and Paralysis stack limit drops to 2; ATK +{0} and attacks 2 targets at once; when Operators within range activate a skill (including Mantra), enemies within range gain 2 stacks of Paralysis (can be triggered at most 3 times); for every 1 stack of Paralysis above the limit on enemies within range, 1 instance of {1} ATK as Elemental Damage jumps between the target and 1 other enemy; there is a short delay between jumps
